page: Microsoft Azure D16ads_v7 is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the Dadsv7 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical AMD EPYC 9V45 cores with a base clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supporting hyper-threading with 2 threads per core. Memory capacity is 64.0 GB, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes 945 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data reveals top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression all ranking in the top 10%. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core, falls into the average category. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, as well as PassMark memory scores, also register average performance.

For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates strong image processing capabilities and top-tier text processing. Large language model inference speeds vary significantly: prompt processing and text generation for small 135M models rank as strong and top-tier respectively, whereas prompt processing for large 70B models is weak, and text generation for 70B models is unsupported.

The server offers a balanced resource profile with dedicated CPU allocation and local storage, providing qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring consistent single-core execution and local disk caching. Appropriate workloads include general-purpose web serving, database operations, text processing, and software compilation.
description: Microsoft Azure D16ads_v7 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs, 8 physical cores, and 64.0 GB of RAM, alongside 945 GB of local SSD storage. Benchmark results indicate top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded compression tests ranking in the top 10%. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth consistently fall within the average range. The server demonstrates strong performance in image processing and small-model LLM inference, though performance drops to weak for large 70B model inference. This instance is suitable for workloads such as database operations, text processing, software compilation, and general-purpose web serving where a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and local storage are required.
